subject: psychic center identification
fact: Thorin, the least magically inclined member of the party, succeeds where all the spellcasters failed — correctly identifying the psychic center of the Hall of Melting Mirrors using a lucky roll and dwarvish intuition.
source_quote: Thorin, the least magically inclined member of the party, succeeds where all the spellcasters failed — correctly identifying the psychic center of the Hall of Melting Mirrors using a lucky roll and dwarvish intuition.

subject: dwarf clarification
fact: Chipgrin remarks he should have asked the dwarf first, before awkwardly clarifying to Zalthir that he meant no offense by calling them a 'surface dweller'.
source_quote: Chipgrin remarks he should have asked the dwarf first, before awkwardly clarifying to Zalthir that he meant no offense by calling them a 'surface dweller'.

subject: bone die origin
fact: The bone die was won off a blind Duergar in Gracklstugh, claimed to be carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie — a die with a memory for the truth.
source_quote: The old mule swore it was carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie, said it had a memory for the truth. I thought he was just trying to cover his losses.

subject: glabbagool transformation
fact: Glabbagool briefly became a bridge between every ooze in the cavern, a single vast mind connecting jellies, puddings, and cubes alike, and told them in his gentle and earnest way that the world was fine and there was no need to kill anyone.
source_quote: Glabbagool briefly became a bridge between every ooze in the cavern, a single vast mind connecting jellies, puddings, and cubes alike. He told them, in his gentle and earnest way, that the world was fine, that everyone could get along, and that there was really no need to kill anyone.

subject: jimjar divine inspection
fact: Zalthir uses a special ability to inspect Jimjar and discovers he possesses divine-level immunities and resistances — immune to poison and psychic damage, cannot be charmed or frightened, shrugs off radiant energy and mundane weapons — a profile matching an angel or deity.
source_quote: Zalthir uses a special ability to inspect Jimjar and discovers he possesses divine-level immunities and resistances. Jimjar notices, winks, and vanishes into thin air — hinting the party will meet again.

subject: zuggtmoy's subtle threat
fact: Jimjar remarks that Juiblex was a loud, messy neighbor, but this sister — Zuggtmoy — prefers to move in while you're sleeping.
source_quote: Juiblex was a loud, messy neighbor, but this sister, she prefers to move in while you're sleeping.

subject: voucher of the varmint
fact: Chief Chipgrin pressed a braided rat's foot into Daz's hand — the Voucher of the Varmint, a token recognized by wererats and outcasts from Blingdenstone all the way to Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Chief Chipgrin pressed a braided rat's foot into Daz's hand — the Voucher of the Varmint, he called it, a token recognized by wererats and outcasts from Blingdenstone all the way to Menzoberranzan.

subject: jimjar vanishing
fact: Jimjar noticed Zalthir's scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel behind him.
source_quote: Jimjar noticed the scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel behind him.

subject: mysterious puffball mushroom
fact: A pale white puffball mushroom grew at impossible speed from a crack in the wall, its scent cloyingly sweet, like a feast left to rot in a hothouse — a sign of Zuggtmoy's quiet, creeping presence.
source_quote: Jimjar pointed to a pale white puffball mushroom growing at impossible speed from a crack in the wall, its scent cloyingly sweet, like a feast left to rot in a hothouse.

subject: glowing geode
fact: A small, luminous rock gifted to the party by the Earth Elemental as a token of favor before it disappeared into the earth. It is valued at 100 gold pieces.
source_quote: The party finds an Earth Elemental struggling to keep the throne room from collapsing, leaking elemental energy through cracks in its form. ... The party drops a small glowing geode as a token of favor.

subject: diggermattock miners patch
fact: A commemorative patch given to Thorin by Diggermattock as recognition of his work helping with the support beams, signifying his status as an honorary member of the mining crew. It was magically mended onto his gear.
source_quote: Diggermattock rewards Thorin with a 'Diggermattock Miners' patch, which is magically mended onto his gear.

subject: bone die
fact: A 20-sided die carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie, won by Jimjar from a blind Duergar in Gracklstugh. When tossed onto Glabbagool, it triggered a mysterious 'blink' that pacified the entire ooze army by correcting the 'world's math.' It is now considered spent and was given to a party member as a keepsake.
source_quote: Jimjar proposes a bet of ten platinum pieces that he can stop the 'noise' of the oozes using a special die. ... Jimjar tosses a bone die onto Glabbagool, triggering a mysterious 'blink' ... Jimjar explains the origin of the bone die, claiming he won it from a blind Duergar in Gracklstugh and that it was carved from a saint's knucklebone.

subject: voucher of the varmint
fact: A braided rat's foot given to Daz by Chief Chipgrin upon the party's departure. It serves as a mark of friendship recognized by wererats and outcasts throughout the Underdark, from Blingdenstone to Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Chief Chipgrin presents Daz with a braided rat's foot Voucher of the Varmint as a sign of friendship with the wererats.

subject: ooze pacification at trader's grotto
fact: Jimjar tossed a bone die onto Glabbagool, triggering a mysterious 'blink' that caused the entire ooze horde to become mindless and peaceful, slithering away into the stonework.
source_quote: Jimjar tosses a bone die onto Glabbagool, triggering a mysterious 'blink' that causes the oozes to become mindless and peaceful. ... Glabbagool briefly connects with the entire ooze horde telepathically, telling them to calm down, leading the mass of jellies and puddings to slither away into the stonework.

subject: council compromise in blingdenstone
fact: The party mediated a peace agreement between the deep gnomes, wererats, and miners guild, establishing sustainable mining practices, granting wererats control of the upper boroughs, and agreeing to reopen Blingdenstone for surface trade.
source_quote: The party proposes that the Gold Whisker wererats take control of the upper burrows to serve as a defense force ... A compromise is reached regarding the mining of the throne room ... Dorbo Diggermattock prepares to reopen Blingdenstone for trade with the surface world.

subject: jimjar's true nature
fact: Jimjar is immune to poison and psychic damage, resistant to radiant and non-magical physical attacks, cannot be charmed or frightened, and vanished into thin air after being inspected — suggesting he is a celestial being or deity.
source_quote: Zalthir uses a special ability to discern Jimjar's resistances and immunities, discovering he is immune to poison and psychic damage, cannot be charmed or frightened, and is resistant to radiant damage and non-magical physical attacks. ... Jimjar winks at the party and vanishes into thin air.

subject: throne room
fact: The site of the Pudding King's defeat, where an Earth Elemental strained to prevent the ceiling from collapsing. Fungi in the area were observed growing at an accelerated rate after the battle.
source_quote: The party finds an Earth Elemental struggling to keep the throne room from collapsing ... The party notices fungi in the area beginning to grow at an accelerated rate, foreshadowing the lingering influence of Zuggtmoy.

subject: hall of melting mirrors
fact: A chamber filled with psychic static where Chipgrin and his wererats were maintaining a chanting vigil to keep the lingering psychic noise at bay.
source_quote: A chamber filled with psychic static where Chipgrin and his wererats were maintaining a chanting vigil to keep the lingering psychic noise at bay.

subject: support beams
fact: An area featuring over-engineered temporary bridges and structural beams being maintained by Gnomish miners amidst black ooze residue, where several miners had suffered burns.
source_quote: An area featuring over-engineered temporary bridges and structural beams being maintained by Gnomish miners amidst black ooze residue, where several miners had suffered burns.

subject: trader's grotto
fact: A Gnomish defensive position in Blingdenstone where a large gnome army gathered at a breached wall to face an encroaching army of uncontrolled oozes.
source_quote: A large Gnomish army gathered at a breached wall to face an encroaching army of uncontrolled oozes.

subject: blingdenstone council room
fact: A meeting hall where the leaders of the deep gnomes, wererats, miners guild, and spiritual enclaves gathered to debate the future of the city and negotiate a lasting peace.
source_quote: The party attends a council meeting where Dorbo Diggermattock expresses concerns about the city's economy, labor shortages, and defense. ... The various factions agree to a peace arrangement.

subject: northern exit tunnels
fact: The set of tunnels leading out of the Underdark toward the surface world, where the party was escorted by a Gnomish honor guard as they prepared to depart.
source_quote: The party is escorted by a Gnomish honor guard as they prepared to depart.

subject: mass healing word
fact: Cast by Grygum to restore the party's vitality and, more significantly, to repair the physical cracks in the Earth Elemental's stone body, allowing it to relax and eventually depart peacefully.
source_quote: Grygum's magic ... repaired the physical cracks in the Earth Elemental's stone body, allowing it to relax and eventually depart peacefully.

subject: lesser restoration
fact: Used by Grygum to treat the burned and wounded Gnomish miners at the support beams.
source_quote: Grygum uses magical healing to treat the burned and wounded Gnomish miners at the support beams.

subject: mending
fact: A cantrip used to magically attach the Diggermattock Miners patch to Thorin's clothing with expert precision.
source_quote: Magically mended onto his gear.

subject: motivational speech
fact: Employed by Daz during the council meeting to inspire the bickering factions of Blingdenstone — including the labor unions and the mining guild — to seek a peaceful compromise and common ground.
source_quote: Daz delivers a motivational speech urging the factions to set aside their egos for a mutual alliance and economic renaissance.

subject: earth elemental
fact: A massive being of stone that sacrificed its energy to hold open a breach in the throne room. It was healed by Grygum's magic before merging back into the earth, and left behind a glowing geode as a token of favor.
source_quote: The party finds an Earth Elemental struggling to keep the throne room from collapsing ... The Earth Elemental stretches and disappears into the dirt, leaving the passage stable. ... The party drops a small glowing geode as a token of favor.

subject: chipgrin
fact: A wererat leader encountered in the Hall of Melting Mirrors who sought the party's help neutralizing psychic noise. He later negotiated for wererat control of the upper boroughs during the council meeting, and gifted Daz the Voucher of the Varmint upon the party's departure.
source_quote: Chipgrin and his wererats were maintaining a chanting vigil ... Chipgrin later negotiated for wererat control of the upper boroughs ... Chief Chipgrin presents Daz with a braided rat's foot Voucher of the Varmint.

subject: glabbagool
fact: An intelligent gelatinous cube and ally to the party, currently carried in a bag of holding. He briefly acted as a telepathic bridge for the ooze horde when Jimjar's bone die was tossed onto him, allowing him to calm the entire swarm.
source_quote: Glabbagool briefly connects with the entire ooze horde telepathically, telling them to calm down ... The party asks Glabbagool about the experience; he describes briefly being part of one big mind with all the oozes.

subject: jimjar
fact: A mysterious deep gnome with a penchant for gambling who used a bone die carved from a saint's knucklebone to pacify the ooze army. He revealed a philosophy of 'world math' and probability before departing. When Zalthir used a special ability to inspect him, he was found to be immune to poison and psychic damage, resistant to radiant and non-magical physical attacks, and unable to be charmed or frightened — before winking and vanishing entirely.
source_quote: Jimjar proposes a bet ... Jimjar tosses a bone die onto Glabbagool ... Zalthir uses a special ability to discern Jimjar's resistances and immunities ... Jimjar winks at the party and vanishes into thin air.

subject: chief dorbo diggermattock
fact: The leader of Blingdenstone who argued for aggressive economic recovery and mithral extraction. He rewarded Thorin with a miners patch and ultimately agreed to a peace arrangement, announcing plans to reopen Blingdenstone for trade.
source_quote: Dorbo Diggermattock expresses concerns about the city's economy ... Diggermattock rewards Thorin with a 'Diggermattock Miners' patch ... Dorbo Diggermattock prepares to reopen Blingdenstone for trade with the surface world.

subject: senni diggermattock
fact: Dorbo's wife and a member of the Gold Whisker clan who advocated for a functional alliance between the gnomes and the wererats, and whose support was noted as helpful to Dorbo's decision-making.
source_quote: Senni Diggermattock ... advocated for a functional alliance between the gnomes and the wererats, and whose support was noted as helpful to Dorbo's decision-making.

subject: burrow warden jadger
fact: A spectral leader of the ghosts who observed the party's departure and dipped his spectral banner in salute as they left Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Burrow Warden Jadger ... dipped his spectral banner in salute as they left Blingdenstone.

subject: dasco pickshine
fact: A representative of the Miners Guild who initially pushed for immediate strip mining to fund city repairs before agreeing to a sustainable mining compromise.
source_quote: Dasco Pickshine ... initially pushed for immediate strip mining to fund city repairs before agreeing to a sustainable mining compromise.

subject: entémoch
fact: The Prince of Good Elementals, mentioned as feeling favorably toward the party after they assisted the Earth Elemental.
source_quote: Entémoch ... feeling favorably toward the party after they assisted the Earth Elemental.
